# Invoice Template

> Invoice Template is a Chrome extension for creating professional invoices. No registration required, works offline, and exports invoices to PDF.

Key facts (from https://invoice-templates-now.com/):

- Platform: Google Chrome extension
- Works completely offline; data stays on the user's device (no cloud storage, no registration)
- Customizable invoice templates with business branding
- Client management: store client information, track invoice status, maintain payment records
- Support for 100+ currencies
- PDF export for sharing and printing

- [Privacy by Design](https://invoice-templates-now.com/privacy-by-design.html): How Invoice Template keeps data on-device with no cloud storage
- [Invoice Generator vs. Spreadsheet](https://invoice-templates-now.com/invoice-generator-vs-spreadsheet.html): Comparison of using the extension versus spreadsheet invoicing
